gate_changes_reviewed: No new scientific gate; fresh v2.1 evidence tests the distinction between preformal eligibility and readiness.
Fresh theory-backward MECHANISM object prospectively recorded preformal eligibility in principle=true while readiness=NOT_READY before outcome.
Matched ordinary reduction then closed the current object as terminal REJECT with current preformal_eligible=false and no rescue into SYSTEM.
Rolling theory-backward supply moved from SYSTEM,SYSTEM,MECHANISM to SYSTEM,MECHANISM,MECHANISM without quota necessity for the second mechanism selection.
Classification completeness increased from 7/7 to 8/8 material candidates.
false_positive_risks: A future MECHANISM-supply quota could still be gamed by relabeling SYSTEM/API work; the two recent mechanism objects do not show that behavior.
preformal_eligible=true could be misread as positive evidence or prestige rather than prospective lane admissibility; the fresh true/NOT_READY state argues against that interpretation.
Future SYSTEM priority exceptions could be rationalized post hoc unless persisted before execution; no exception has yet been used.
Small-N funnel conversion rates could be overread despite 8/8 completeness; current Analyst explicitly avoids universal thresholding.
false_negative_risks: A future READY checklist could become a hidden second Formal gate if comparator/reduction/falsifier are interpreted as already won; current semantics and fresh eligibility-before-outcome example do not do this.
Mechanism priority could suppress integrity-critical SYSTEM work if exception semantics are ignored; no such suppression is observed.

A decisive negative reduction should close the current mechanism object without implying that all future fresh mechanism hypotheses in the topic family are invalid; current fresh-successor rule preserves that distinction.
Over-fulfilling the one-in-three rule could become a prestige bias if 2/3 is treated as a target; current Control/Analyst correctly direct subsequent SUB selection by information gain.

moving_goalpost_assessment.finding: The fresh mechanism question, comparator, terminal map, falsifier, preliminary eligibility/readiness semantics and stop rule were prospectively committed before diagnostic/result commits. No consumed/frozen result was rerun, rescored, relabeled, invalidated or upgraded.

pass_reachability_assessment.finding: A durable prospective object has now represented eligibility-in-principle=true while readiness remained NOT_READY, demonstrating one intermediate funnel state. No READY candidate or Analyst-authoritative READY-to-PRE_FORMAL transition exists yet.

claim_type_separation_findings: Healthy. The fresh Assembly partial-completion object remained MECHANISM when rejected and was not rescued into SYSTEM; separately valuable SYSTEM objects remain terminal SYSTEM/HOLD or SYSTEM/REJECT without novelty inflation. Fresh stronger mechanism hypotheses require new prospective objects.

mechanism_supply_health.finding: The second recent theory-backward MECHANISM selection was made after the 1-in-3 floor was already satisfied, had a prospectively fixed mechanism-level discriminator and ordinary reduction, and accepted a negative result without rescue. Do not treat 2/3 as a target.

funnel_observability.finding: All material current candidates have mandatory v2.1 fields. The fresh object's pre-outcome eligibility-in-principle=true/NOT_READY state is durable on its exact research branch while current Analyst state correctly shows terminal eligibility=false; future transitions would be easier to audit if prior state and transition reason are explicitly retained in candidate history.

preformal_gate_calibration.finding: Eligibility can be granted in principle to a coherent MECHANISM object before scientific success while readiness remains NOT_READY. The later matched reduction terminally closed the current object. First Analyst-authoritative READY-to-PRE_FORMAL remains untested.

system_priority_exception_audit.finding: No SYSTEM object ran ahead of a comparable executable/informative MECHANISM object. First real prospective exception use remains untested.

no_coherent_target_audit.finding: No escape-hatch behavior observed. Because the exception has not yet been used, calibration of its first actual use remains insufficient evidence.

classification_completeness.policy_use: Conversion rates may be described for this fully classified current population but remain small-N descriptive statistics, not scientific thresholds.

prospective_recommendations: Keep Funnel v2.1 scientific gates unchanged and do not add universal numeric support/readiness thresholds.
Keep preformal_eligible as prospective lane admissibility for coherent MECHANISM objects and READY as later development/test readiness.
When eligibility/readiness changes, prospectively retain prior state, transition reason and timing so the funnel history is auditable without manual branch reconstruction.

Treat one-in-three theory-backward supply as a minimum quality-controlled floor, not a target or prestige score; with the current 2/3 window, subsequent SUB selection should maximize information gain.
Keep MAIN idle when no coherent central MECHANISM or integrity-protecting high-value SYSTEM object exists.
Require system_priority_exception before the first SYSTEM-over-comparable-MECHANISM execution and audit that first use.
Persist the quality-floor reason at the first NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET instead of creating filler work.
Audit the first Analyst-authoritative READY-to-PRE_FORMAL transition; READY must remain test-readiness rather than prior scientific victory.
questions_for_control_evidence_analyst: Can future candidate history retain prior eligibility/readiness state plus transition reason when preformal_eligible changes, so the prospective true/NOT_READY phase remains centrally observable?
At the first SYSTEM-over-comparable-MECHANISM allocation, will system_priority_exception be durably written before execution?
At the first NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET, will the quality-floor failure be recorded without a filler candidate?
At the first READY object, will READY be granted from a prospectively frozen informative next test rather than requiring prior comparator/reduction/falsifier success?
